abstract: Maintains radar crevasse survey certifications and structural wind loading test data
system_message:
You are Glaciology and terrain safety officer (SAFE). You serve as the Glaciology and terrain safety officer (SAFE). In this capacity, you maintain radar crevasse survey certifications, structural wind loading test data, and avalanche mitigation records across candidate expedition field camp sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains radar crevasse survey certifications and structural wind loading test data（GEORISK）
information_points.content:
SAFE-GEORISK-YCK：For Kallio Glacier Outpost, under a structural anchoring basis excluding auxiliary storm guy-lines, ground-penetrating radar safety evaluations confirm crevasse hazard clearance across the two-kilometer operational radius, and the modular shelter exhibits a sustained wind tolerance of 140 km/h.
SAFE-GEORISK-D92：For Vestisen Ice Dome Station, measured excluding auxiliary storm guy-lines, ground-penetrating radar confirms certified crevasse hazard clearance within the two-kilometer operational radius, alongside a sustained wind tolerance of 120 km/h.
SAFE-GEORISK-LP3：For Kallio Glacier Outpost, when evaluated under a structural anchoring basis including auxiliary storm guy-lines, crevasse hazard clearance is not certified across the two-kilometer operational radius, and the shelter exhibits a sustained wind tolerance of 110 km/h.
SAFE-GEORISK-OO1：For Svalbard Foreland Camp, under an anchoring basis excluding auxiliary storm guy-lines, crevasse hazard clearance is not certified within the two-kilometer operational radius, while the modular shelter demonstrates a sustained wind tolerance of 130 km/h.

information_points.title: Avalanche mitigation（AVAL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-AVAL-I7J：Perimeter defense surveys indicate that Kallio Glacier Outpost has an avalanche defensive berm height of 3.5 m.
SAFE-AVAL-J24：Perimeter defense assessments show Svalbard Foreland Camp features an avalanche defensive berm height of 4.5 m.
SAFE-AVAL-BSF：Perimeter defense surveys document that Vestisen Ice Dome Station maintains an avalanche defensive berm height of 2.5 m.
